title: German Potato Stew
description: A hearty German stew made with stewed potatoes, irish potatoes, and a hint of irish flavor. Perfect for a cold winter's day.

ingredients.name: Chewy stew meat
ingredients.notes: Make sure to brown the meat before stewing

instructions: Brown the stew meat in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Remove the browned meat from the pot and set aside.
Add the sliced onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the browned meat back to the pot, along with the irish potatoes and yellow potatoes.
Pour in the water and bring the stew to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
